coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed PMT summary and all ten SR Electricity pages against 4.2. Added charge/energy distinction, branch changes with fixed supply, conditional power reasoning, complete AC cycles and negative-charge force direction. All circuit symbols, I–V graphs and three practical circuit diagrams retained. Rejected PMT misprinted resistance sum and E = PI, fixed-resistor constant at all temperatures, universal inverse-gradient claim for curved I–V graphs and SR battery-life assertion. Omitted out-of-spec AC power factors, Coulomb-law calculation and reciprocal parallel-resistance formula.
